name: Wang Ch’i
bio: Wang Ch’i (王淇) was a Sung poet; the sources give no dates.

The poems here are from the Qianjiashi (千家詩, Poems of a Thousand Poets), the Song-Ming schoolroom anthology of Tang and Song verse attributed to Xie Fangde and Wang Xiang, taken from the chinese-poetry dataset (MIT); the original characters are given as printed there.

poems.title: 春暮遊小園 (Chun mu you xiao yuan)
poems.author: Wang Ch’i
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
一從梅粉褪殘妝，塗抹新紅上海棠。
開到荼蘼花事了，絲絲夭棘出莓牆。

poems.title: 梅 (Mei)
poems.author: Wang Ch’i
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
不受塵埃半點侵，竹籬茅舍自甘心。
只因誤識林和靖，惹得詩人說到今。

poems.title: 上元應制 (Shang yuan ying zhi)
poems.author: Wang Ch’i
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
雪消華月滿仙台，萬燭當樓寶扇開。
雙鳳雲中扶輦下，六鰲海上駕山來。
鎬京春酒沾周宴，汾水秋風陋漢才。
一曲昇平人盡樂，君王又進紫霞杯。
